law: Only explicitly registered active Ed25519 public keys may attest quality-verification outcomes. Private keys must remain in the verifier's protected runtime secret store and must never be committed.
notes: No verifier keys are provisioned in this initial registry.
Positive adaptive learning remains blocked until a verifier key is registered through the existing GATED governance path.
The executor cannot authorize itself by supplying receipt_integrity, signature_valid, or other self-reported booleans.
Each key is bound to one agent_id and the quality_verification purpose.
